result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and the same behaviour. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli compile`). I didn't run any tests or the command itself, so the `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html` output hasn't been checked.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. I also added `analyzeLandscape` to the no-argument usage overview, using the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run` sends both command names to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method. With `-help`, the usage printed is for whichever name was typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It lists `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape` (noting that `updateLandscape` is the older name) and `updateConfig`.
